trips.route_note: Take the JR Yokosuka Line from Tokyo Station directly to Kamakura (about an hour), then walk or use the Enoden tram for the Great Buddha and Hase area.
trips.why: A direct JR Yokosuka Line train from Tokyo Station takes about 55 minutes and drops you right in Kamakura, with the Enoden tram covering the Great Buddha and Hase area.
know: The Great Buddha and Hase-dera are a short Enoden tram ride from Kamakura Station
Weekends and spring/autumn are crowded, so go on a weekday morning
Many temples close around late afternoon

bus.via: Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal to Tomei Matsuda

trips.route_note: Take the Odakyu Romancecar from Shinjuku to Hakone-Yumoto, then use the Hakone Tozan railway, cable car, and ropeway to loop around the sights.
see: Lake Ashi and pirate ship cruise
trips.why: The Odakyu Romancecar takes about 1h 27m from Shinjuku, and the Hakone Tozan railway, cable car, and ropeway connect the sights in one loop, so it beats the 2h 22m bus and the 81-minute drive.
know: Romancecar seats are reserved, so book ahead on busy days and weekends.
Mount Fuji views depend on clear weather, so check the forecast before you go.
Rail and cable car sights are spread across the area, so allow a full day for the loop.

trips.route_note: Take the Tobu Nikko Line limited express from Asakusa or the JR Tohoku Shinkansen to Utsunomiya then the JR Nikko Line; from Nikko Station a bus reaches the shrine area.
trips.why: The Tobu limited express reaches Nikko in about 1h57m, and a local bus covers the last stretch to the shrine area, so a car isn't needed.
know: Reserve the Tobu limited express seats in advance, especially in autumn
A bus from Nikko Station is needed to reach the shrine area
Shrines are best visited in spring or autumn; winter can bring snow and ice

trips.label: Mt Fuji & Lake Kawaguchi

bus.via: Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal to Kawaguchiko Sta.

trips.route_note: Take the Fuji Excursion limited express from Shinjuku direct to Kawaguchiko, or a highway bus from Shinjuku; local buses connect the lake viewpoints.
see: Lake Kawaguchi north shore views of Mt Fuji
trips.tour_query: Mt Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi day trip from Tokyo
trips.why: The highway bus from Shinjuku is the fastest option and drops you right at Kawaguchiko Station near the lake viewpoints.
know: Book the Shinjuku highway bus in advance, especially on weekends and holidays
Mt. Fuji views are clearest in the cooler months and early morning
Local buses connect the lake viewpoints once you arrive

trips.route_note: Take the JR Tokaido or Yokosuka Line from Tokyo Station or the Tokyu Toyoko Line from Shibuya directly to Yokohama, about 30 minutes.
trips.why: The train takes about 29 minutes directly from Tokyo Station, which is far faster and cheaper than the 40-minute drive or the 14900 JPY taxi.
know: Direct JR and Tokyu lines run frequently, so no planning or booking is needed.
Yokohama Chinatown and the Minato Mirai waterfront are both walkable from the station.
